claims.assertion: Yazhi says she teleports through trance, altered time perception, and destination visualization, arriving instantly; carrying cargo exhausts her.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu

claims.assertion: Yazhi says wall-phasing shifts her perceived density, causing matter to repel rather than trap her.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu

claims.assertion: Yazhi reports transporting objects and plants; living plants cling to her field, once trapping her in a thorn bush.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She had not tried animals or people.

claims.assertion: Yazhi describes temporal jumps to remembered places, including revisiting a detailed childhood setting and meeting her younger self.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu
